tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and confined to H = 0.16–0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the response reverses and constrains its magnitude near the forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-horizon reversal model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term depends mainly on the amplitude-to-timescale ratio. Similar pilot fits can therefore predict different responses at H = 23.9.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have s_grad = 0, making the sink coefficient unidentifiable, and none sample the slow response directly.
Finer sampling alone does not address the missing long-horizon observations.
It does not test the slow reversal.
